trends.name: Iran Strait Crisis & Oil Shock
trends.summary: Trump's escalating Iran threats and Tuesday deadline for Strait of Hormuz closure are driving WTI crude above $115/barrel (+3.0% futures). Bahrain calling for UN resolution to reopen strait. Oil surge on track to push US CPI to 3.7% (highest since Sept 2023) if sustained 7 weeks, immediately pressuring equities (-0.7% to -0.8% S&P/Nasdaq futures).

trends.name: Energy Crisis: Diesel Shortages & Surging Costs
trends.summary: Diesel prices surge above $8/barrel in San Francisco amid Gulf supply shock. California facing wildfire/drought risks with only 18% snowpack entering dry season. Energy cost inflation rippling through airlines (Delta earnings) and transportation sector as earnings season opens.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk Embedded in S&P 500
trends.summary: Analysis of 50 S&P 500 10-Ks reveals massive geopolitical risk disclosures: Morgan Stanley 221 mentions, Citigroup 269 mentions of war/sanctions/tariffs/supply chain risks. Rubio statements on NATO/Europe funding re-examination signal potential US military realignment impacting defense spending and allied markets.

trends.name: AI Valuation & Leadership Uncertainty
trends.summary: IBM faces questions around AI value capture despite strong execution. OpenAI's Fidji Simo takes medical leave amid leadership changes. Market skeptical mega IPOs (SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI) can sustain valuations without near-term revenue catalysts. AI capex narratives facing credibility gap.

trends.name: Data Center Expansion Facing State Bans
trends.summary: Maine becomes first US state to ban new data centers; 10 additional states considering similar restrictions. Bill freezes massive construction projects until late 2027. Directly threatens AI infrastructure capex plans and NVIDIA/semiconductor ecosystem expansion bets.

trends.name: Gold Mining Sector Consolidation Opportunity
trends.summary: GDX (gold mining ETF) showing solid valuations amid new macro risks from geopolitical tensions and inflation surge. Investors positioning for energy/commodity inflation hedge as Iran crisis escalates and oil/energy costs spike.

trends.name: Japan & South Korea Stock Rally on Iran Comments
trends.summary: Japanese and South Korean equities rallying as investors assess Trump's Iran war deadline extensions. FLJP (Japanese equity ETF) seeing buying interest as traders go long Japanese exposure amid geopolitical uncertainty favoring defensive Asian assets.

trends.name: Dividend & Income ETF Structural Shifts
trends.summary: SCHD experiencing huge changes significantly impacting holdings; JEPQ showing minimal hedge benefit in 2026's volatile environment (downgrade); COWZ ($18B cash cows ETF) opportunity emerging as valuations reset. Income investors reassessing yield sustainability amid inflation spike.

trends.name: China E-Commerce Regulatory Framework Shift
trends.summary: China Commerce Ministry unveils framework enhancing e-commerce with emphasis on both growth AND regulatory fairness, aligning domestic/global strategies. Signals potential easing of tech regulation after years of crackdowns, potentially bullish for Alibaba/JD.com and ADR tech names.

trends.name: April Seasonal Strength Jeopardized by Macro Headwinds
trends.summary: Despite April's typical seasonal strength, three critical factors threaten rally: oil/energy inflation, geopolitical escalation (Iran), and rising rate expectations from CPI pressure. Market breadth analysis suggests stocks want higher but macro crosswinds creating whipsaw risk.

trends.name: Defense & Aerospace Capex Beneficiaries Emerging
trends.summary: Archer Aviation (eVTOL) and broader defense sector benefiting from NATO re-examination and geopolitical tensions. Europe exploring defense alternatives ('anything but autos'). Iran escalation potentially driving defense budget increases and contractor order flow.

trends.name: Inflation-Resistant Value Plays Reassessment
trends.summary: Fiserv (deeply undervalued, weak rebound), United Rentals (steady cash machine, discounted), Olin (results bottoming), Devon Energy (merger + Iran war tailwinds) all reassessed as investors hunt inflation hedges and cash flow stability. Energy/industrials gaining relative strength.
